memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anemia.
Evidence: fatigue, pallor, low hemoglobin 9.2 g/dL, ferritin 12 ng/mL, MCV 68 fL. Symptoms and examination: she reports tiredness on exertion, mild dyspnea walking short distances, appears pale conjunctiva, no lymphadenopathy, lungs clear. Smoking status: former smoker, 20 pack-years, quit 2005.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg tablet, oral, once daily for 12 weeks.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 10.1 g/dL (13.0-17.0). Serum ferritin 18 ng/mL (15-150). MCV 70 fL (80-100).

memories.author: D05

memories.author: D05
